name: Torwa Pathfinder
summary: At Un'Goro Crater's entrance, Torwa Pathfinder watches and tracks the wilds. The lone tauren hunter camps below the ramp from Tanaris, studying the basin's primordial wildlife and dangerous predators. Adventurers who seek to test themselves against its legendary beasts come to him for guidance.

sections.title: Watcher at the Threshold
sections.body: Torwa Pathfinder camps at the crater's eastern base, where Tanaris's desert gives way to jungle. He respects Un'Goro's wild forces and watches newcomers in his own way, knowing careless wanderers can become prey. His camp gives travelers a place to pause before they enter the jungle depths.

sections.title: The Hunt for Lar'korwi
sections.body: Torwa Pathfinder spends much of his time tracking Lar'korwi, a fierce and cunning raptor in the crater's north. Brute strength alone will not bring down such a predator. He teaches hunters to study its feeding habits, then use fresh carcass meat and glands as bait to draw Lar'korwi into the open.

sections.title: Primal Poisons and Beasts
sections.body: Torwa Pathfinder studies poisonous plants and aggressive ape colonies, as well as the crater's raptors. He sends travelers to gather venom from volatile bloodpetals and watch powerful beasts such as U'cha, the mighty gorilla. Torwa seeks to understand how nature's deadliest defenses work in isolation.

faq.q: Where can I find Torwa Pathfinder?
faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder camps at Un'Goro Crater's eastern edge, near the foot of the winding ramp up to Tanaris.
Lar'korwi is a fierce and cunning raptor that roams Un'Goro Crater. Torwa teaches hunters to use bait made from fresh carcass meat and glands to draw it into the open.

faq.q: Does Torwa only offer quests to Horde players?
faq.answer: No. Torwa Pathfinder offers his tracking wisdom and hunting challenges to capable adventurers of both the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.q: Why is Torwa interested in Bloodpetals?
faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder studies the lethal defenses of Un'Goro's native plants. He asks adventurers to gather secretions from aggressive bloodpetals so he can understand and test their natural toxins.
U'cha is a powerful gorilla living in Un'Goro's caves and ape territories. Torwa challenges hunters to defeat U'cha and prove their skill against the basin's strongest beasts.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can learn from Torwa Pathfinder's patience and craft. To lure an apex predator, study its diet, scent, and territorial habits instead of relying on raw force.
As a tauren, you may find Torwa Pathfinder's camp at the crater's edge a reassuring reminder of your people's reverence for nature amid Un'Goro's prehistoric wilds.
